title: Aurum Alpha erasure ledger entry
description: standards/028-backup-and-recovery.md BR6: one entry per erased subject per erasure request, written in the erasure job's own transaction to a table in the service's database and copied, through the outbox, to an append-only location in the backup failure domain. After any restore, every entry whose erased_at is later than the copy's as_of is replayed before the service reports ready, so that a restore never resurrects erased data. The entry carries identifiers and never personal data - it is kept for the whole erasure_horizon - and its property set is closed so that no personal field can be added to it later. schemaVersion 1 - evolves additively per PC6.

entry_id.description: BR6: the entry's own public id, minted by the erasure job; the outbox message that carries the copy uses it as the event id, so a redelivered copy is a repeat under 055 AM3.

subject_id.description: BR6: the erased subject's public id (020 IP1), never an internal key and never an email or a name. An id is not personal data; it is what replay erases by.

subject_type.description: BR6: the entity the subject id names, in the service's own vocabulary: user, contact, applicant.

tenant_id.description: BR6: the tenant the subject belonged to (040 OC2), where tenant context exists, so replay runs the erasure in the right isolation context (025 SD6).

request_id.description: BR6: the public id of the erasure request resource the data subject rights standard defines, so the entry joins to the request and its audit event (080 AE5).

erased_at.description: BR6: when the erasure job committed (020 IP4). Replay applies every entry later than the restored copy's as_of; an earlier entry replays as a no-op.

entities.description: BR6: what the erasure touched and how, so that a replay and a verification know what to expect absent, transformed or redacted.

entity.description: The table, collection or bucket prefix, in 025 SD10's snake_case.

treatment.description: delete: the subject's rows or objects were removed (025 SD12). anonymise: rows were kept and the subject's fields transformed by the declared transformation. redact: audit events were kept and their identification replaced with a tombstone (080 AE7). A retained row under a legal basis does not appear here, because nothing was done to it.

count.description: How many rows, objects or events received the treatment; what a replay's verification compares against.

trace_id.description: 040 OC1: the erasure run's trace, so the entry leads to the run that wrote it.
